title: A geometric-point morphism gives an equivalence of pointed étale neighbourhoods
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let s : Spec k → S and s' : Spec k' → S be geometric points [def-weil-geometric-point]. For a scheme morphism a : Spec k → Spec k' satisfying a ≫ s' = s, precomposition with a gives an equivalence from the category of pointed étale neighbourhoods of s' to that of s [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods], over the small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. On objects it sends (U,t) to (U,a ≫ t), and on arrows it preserves the underlying S-morphism.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Remark 04FN (remark-map-stalks, line 3416): the canonical map of stalks of a morphism of geometric points, 'since the functor above is clearly an equivalence ... this canonical map is an isomorphism of stalk functors'; used in the paragraph before Definition 04FS (line 3984)

proof.text: Write a = Spec.map beta using Spec.map_surjective. For each etale U over S, injectivity of precomposition on its pointed lifts follows by Over.OverMorphism.ext and Scheme.SpecMap_comp_injective beta [lem-exc-field-point-precomposition-injective]. The equality of images gives equality of the underlying scheme maps, and hence equality in the slice category.

For a lift x of s to U, ha gives x.left ≫ U.hom = Spec.map beta ≫ s'. Apply U.hom.exists_SpecMap_comp_eq_of_isSepClosed [lem-exc-etale-lift-separably-closed-factorization] to obtain y with Spec.map beta ≫ y = x.left and y ≫ U.hom = s'. Over.homMk y is the required preimage. Thus each component of alpha is bijective. Algebraically closed fields are separably closed, so the upstream lemma applies.

ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective and NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app turn componentwise bijectivity into IsIso alpha. Apply the proved generic construction NatIso.mapElements (asIso alpha), whose forward functor is definitionally CategoryOfElements.map alpha, and use its isEquivalence_functor. The construction preserves the underlying etale objects and arrows.

proof_origin.place: Scheme.Hom.exists_SpecMap_comp_eq_of_isSepClosed; Scheme.SpecMap_comp_injective in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.ResidueField; NatIso.mapElements in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Elements. These proved tools implement the field-embedding argument of Stacks Tag 04FN without new holes.

lean.statement:
theorem geometricPointMorphism_category_equivalence
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {k k' : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k'] (s : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (s' : Spec (.of k') ⟶ S)
    (a : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of k')) (ha : a ≫ s' = s) :
    let b : Over.mk s ⟶ Over.mk s' := Over.homMk a ha
    let α : (pointSmallEtale s').fiber ⟶ (pointSmallEtale s).fiber :=
      Functor.whiskerLeft (Etale.forget S) (coyoneda.map b.op)
    (CategoryOfElements.map α).IsEquivalence
